title: 🗂️ Repo codebase fixtures and wire shapes
description: 🗂️ The three vector files the codebase cases read, and the projections every implementation of the repository walk, the technology and bundle detection, the artifact id builders and the ignore integration must produce.

path.description: 🛤️ Slash-separated path relative to the materialised repository root.

content.description: 📄️ Exact file content; parent directories are created as needed.

WalkProjection.description: 🚶️ What the workspace-walk case projects: the considered files in walk order, plus the bundle and folder aggregates keyed off them.

bundles.description: 🧱️ One `id|folder|folders|files|lines` line per bundle, in aggregate order.

folders.description: 📁️ One `path|id|files|lines` line per folder, in aggregate order.

IdProjection.description: 🪪️ What the artifact-id-builders case projects: one `name=id` entry per vector, in vector order.

DetectionProjection.description: 📦️ What the technology-bundle-detection case projects: one line per technology and one per bundle, in detection order.

IgnoreProjection.description: 🙈️ What the ignore-integration case projects: one `name=excluded,gitignored,generated` entry per vector, plus the kept and dropped halves of a filtered walk.
